about: Star positions for the assembl Lab Matariki sky explorer (educational, not production). Cluster: Gaia DR3 (ESA/Gaia/DPAC, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO), simple kinematic selection, cross-matched to HYG v4.4 for HIP/HD ids, names and spectral types. Background: HYG v4.4 (astronexus, CC BY-SA 4.0), stars to magnitude 6.5. This derived file is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. Built by scripts/build-matariki-sky-data.py.
